mapper.select: SELECT desired_sequence FROM iot_device WHERE id = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_desired_property ( device_id, binding_generation, property_code, desired_sequence, value_json) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{bindingGeneration}, #{propertyCode}, #{desiredSequence}, CAST(#{valueJson} AS JSONB)) ON CONFLICT (device_id, binding_generation, property_code) DO UPDATE SET desired_sequence = EXCLUDED.desired_sequence, value_json = EXCLUDED.value_json, converged_at = NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iot_desired_property WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND binding_generation = #{bindingGeneration}
